title: Case: A high-value shipment lacks an accessible proof-of-delivery record
context: The recipient confirms receipt of a high-value camera accessory, but the order view lacks the handover record. Carrier support may release a redacted inline record to this verified recipient.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-030: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. photo-evidence-576.txt is mentioned but missing from the case; the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
